vaccinations.schedule_help: Enter each dose's age in months from birth, comma-separated. Examples: "0, 2, 4, 6" = at birth, then 2, 4, 6 months. For a booster at a specific age add it: "2, 4, 6, 18" (booster at 18 months), or "12, 18" for two doses. For years multiply by 12 (2 years = 24, 4 years = 48).

reception_guide.title: Reception guide — visit & collection cycle
reception_guide.flow1: Book the appointment or register a walk-in — both follow the same path.
reception_guide.flow2: The doctor examines and adds any extra services (echo/session/vaccine…) during the visit — they appear automatically at checkout.
reception_guide.flow3: Collect only via the 💳 button on the appointment card: the screen shows everything due (visit fee + doctor-added services + unbilled vaccines) with visible, reviewable prices.
reception_guide.flow4: If the patient pays later: confirm the invoice without payment — an "unpaid" badge stays on the board until settled.
reception_guide.flow5: Any outstanding balance from previous days shows automatically on the patient's board card — no need to hunt for it.
reception_guide.warn_once: Every service/vaccine is billed exactly once — the system marks it automatically and it will never repeat on another invoice.
reception_guide.manual_invoice_note: Use the manual invoice (Finance → New invoice) only for product sales without a visit or special cases — it is not a substitute for the checkout screen.
